items.settingsPath: Reinstall Copilot from the Microsoft Store, or undo the run.
items.name: Copilot app and taskbar entry
items.desc: The Copilot appx package, its taskbar button, and Win+C, plus the machine-wide policy that keeps it gone in Windows, Edge, and Game Bar.

items.settingsPath: Settings > Personalization > Text input > Customize Copilot key, or undo the run.
items.name: Copilot key acts as Right Ctrl
items.desc: Uses the native setting where the build has it, otherwise writes a PowerToys chord remap for Win+Shift+F23.

items.settingsPath: Settings > Privacy and security > Recall and snapshots, and turn snapshots back on.
items.name: Recall (screen snapshots)
items.desc: Removes the optional feature, its scheduled tasks, and any stored snapshot database.

items.settingsPath: Undo the run, or turn Click to Do back on in Settings > Privacy and security.
items.name: Click to Do
items.desc: The Win+Click AI actions overlay.

items.settingsPath: Undo the run to put the AI actions entry back in the right-click menu.
items.name: AI actions in File Explorer
items.desc: Right-click AI actions and AI image search in Explorer.

items.settingsPath: Undo the run.
items.name: AI agent in Settings
items.desc: The natural-language agent in Settings search.

items.settingsPath: Undo the run.
items.name: Paint AI features
items.desc: Cocreator, Image Creator, Generative Fill, Generative Erase and Remove Background. Paint itself stays.

items.settingsPath: Undo the run, or sign in again in Notepad.
items.name: Notepad AI features
items.desc: Rewrite, Summarize, and Copilot. Notepad itself stays.

items.settingsPath: Undo the run.
items.name: Photos AI features
items.desc: Restyle, Generative Erase, and Image Creator.

items.settingsPath: Undo the run.
items.name: Writing Assistant package
items.desc: System-wide AI rewrite and suggestion service.

items.settingsPath: Undo the run.
items.name: AugLoop text service
items.desc: AI text prediction plumbing shared with Office. It ships as an in-box component that Windows refuses to uninstall, so only the deprovisioning route reaches it.
items.riskNote: Inline text suggestions in Office, and some Store apps, stop working. The Copilot policy blocks already stop it being used, so this is the difference between blocked and gone.

items.settingsPath: Undo the run.
items.name: AI Fabric / Windows AI Foundry runtime
items.desc: The on-device AI model runtime, including Phi Silica. It ships as an in-box component that Windows refuses to uninstall, so only the deprovisioning route reaches it; the AI policy blocks stop it being used either way.
items.riskNote: Where the package can be removed, Store apps that ask Windows for local inference lose those features. Recall and Click to Do are handled by their own items.

items.settingsPath: Undo the run. The package is serviced by Windows Update and cannot be reinstalled from the Store.
items.name: CoreAI system package
items.desc: The shell's core AI integration package.
items.riskNote: The deepest AI hook in the shell. On some builds removing it destabilises Explorer or the Settings app, so a health check runs immediately after, and reports if the shell broke.

items.settingsPath: Undo the run.
items.name: Windows Studio Effects
items.desc: AI webcam background blur, eye contact correction, and auto-framing.
items.riskNote: If you use background blur or eye contact on video calls, keep this. Nothing else in Windows replaces them.

items.settingsPath: Settings > Privacy and security > Search permissions, and turn cloud content search back on. Some of it also needs the run undone.
symptoms: cannot search the web from start
items.name: Bing and AI results in Start search
items.desc: Local search stays; web and AI answers go.

items.settingsPath: Undo the run, or reinstall from the Microsoft Store.
items.name: M365 Copilot Companions
items.desc: People, File, and Calendar Copilot companion apps.

items.settingsPath: Undo the run, or turn the sidebar back on in Edge settings.
items.name: Edge Copilot and Discover
items.desc: Sidebar, Copilot mode, Discover, and AI features in Edge.

items.settingsPath: Undo the run.
items.name: Gaming Copilot
items.desc: The Copilot surface inside Game Bar.

items.settingsPath: Undo the run.
items.name: Block AI packages from returning
items.desc: Sets machine policy so removed AI components are not re-delivered.
items.riskNote: Sets machine-wide policy. A Windows feature update can reset it, so re-check after major updates.

items.settingsPath: services.msc, find the AI fabric service, and set it back to Manual.
items.name: Windows AI fabric service
items.desc: The background service the on-device AI features run on. Removing the apps leaves it behind and it starts anyway.
items.riskNote: Anything relying on on-device AI stops working, including Recall, Click to Do, and the AI features in Paint and Notepad. Reverses cleanly from the rollback script.
